vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2375: tame beads/records auto-commit churn on main — debounce, batch, and auto-push policy

plan.title: chore(state-plane): tame beads/records auto-commit churn on main — debounce, batch, and auto-push policy
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: src/lib/pan-dir/auto-commit.ts commits beads/records state to LOCAL main at high frequency (~64 commits/24h). Its 2s debounce resets on every write, and there is no push policy — so local main sits perpetually ahead of origin (ahead-10 observed twice on 2026-07-06). That makes pan reload deploy stale code (PAN-2095 root), misleads disk audits, forces humans to rebase noise commits, and pollutes history with ~60+ commits/day.
narratives.Proposal: Land against docs/STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY.md. (1) Create the ONE canonical shared predicate src/lib/state-plane.ts (STATE_PLANE_PATHS + isStatePlaneOnlyDiff) with a CI single-source guard (rule 6). (2) Convert queueAutoCommit from reset-on-write debounce to fixed-window coalescing (default 10 min, env override) — one commit per window — and flush pending commits on process shutdown. (3) After each flush commit on main, push origin main ff-only; on non-ff rejection, rebase state-only commits onto origin/main and retry once ONLY when the tree is clean and the diff is state-plane-only, else surface loudly. (4) Add a getMainDivergence helper surfaced by both pan doctor and the deacon health surface so silent ahead/behind divergence is visible.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Moving state commits off the main working branch onto a dedicated state branch/worktree (evaluated and rejected; the pan_records infra-repo path already exists and debounce+push solve every stated symptom).
- Gitignoring or otherwise removing any state-plane path from git (policy rule 1 forbids it).
- Changing source-code review/merge/verdict behavior (policy rule 4 loosens nothing about code review).
- Refactoring the other cluster gates (PAN-2417/2167/2406/2386) to consume the new predicate — this issue only creates it; siblings adopt it.

autoDecisions.summary: PAN-2375 creates the canonical isStatePlaneOnlyDiff module rather than consuming a sibling's.
autoDecisions.rationale: The predicate does not exist yet (only a comment at deacon.ts:1522) and FR-5's rebase-safety needs it. Policy rule 6 mandates one path list in one place; creating it here and having siblings consume it prevents parallel copies.

autoDecisions.summary: Flush window defaults to 10 minutes, overridable via OVERDECK_STATE_FLUSH_WINDOW_MS.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's stated example, bounds history pollution, and the shutdown flush caps worst-case staleness.
One in-flight window's commit is normal; two-plus signals push failure. Any behind on local main drives stale pan reload.

autoDecisions.summary: Deliverable 4 (dedicated state branch/worktree) rejected and recorded as NonGoal.
autoDecisions.rationale: The two-door model already supports a dedicated infra repo via pan_records.repo + repoRoot (PAN-1908); debounce + push fix every symptom without a migration touching every state reader.

autoDecisions.summary: Config via module constants + env overrides, not config-yaml plumbing.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the existing DEBOUNCE_MS constant style and keeps the change surgical.

items.title: Create canonical src/lib/state-plane.ts (STATE_PLANE_PATHS + isStatePlaneOnlyDiff)

expected_outputs: state-plane.test.ts passes with cases for state-only, mixed, and source-only diffs

narrative.Action: Before writing, git fetch origin/main and confirm no equivalent module already exists (hazard H1) — consume it if present. Otherwise create src/lib/state-plane.ts exporting: (a) STATE_PLANE_PATHS as the verbatim policy-glossary list — .pan/records/, .pan/continues/, .pan/continue.json, .pan/specs/, .beads/, .pan/test/, .pan/review/, .pan/feedback/; and (b) async isStatePlaneOnlyDiff(baseSha, tipSha, repoRoot) that runs `git diff --name-only baseSha tipSha` in repoRoot and returns true iff every changed path matches a STATE_PLANE_PATHS entry (empty diff => true). Add a comment noting .pan/specs/ is path-included though the policy scopes it to status-field flips (H5). This is the shared predicate for the whole state-plane cluster (rule 6); do not inline the path list anywhere else.

Convert auto-commit from reset-on-write debounce to fixed-window coalescing (default 10 min)

expected_outputs: auto-commit.test.ts passes including a new fixed-window coalescing test using fake timers

narrative.Action: In queueAutoCommit (auto-commit.ts:181-186), for an existing pending batch add paths/subjects but DO NOT clearTimeout+reschedule — keep the window timer set at first-queue time so all writes inside the window coalesce into one commit. Replace DEBOUNCE_MS=2000 with FLUSH_WINDOW_MS defaulting to 600000 (10 min), overridable via process.env.OVERDECK_STATE_FLUSH_WINDOW_MS. Update the module doc comment. Tests MUST use vi.useFakeTimers()+vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync() (H4/NFR-3).

items.title: Given two queueAutoCommit calls within one window, When the window elapses, Then exactly one commit is produced (the window timer is not reset by the second call)
The flush window defaults to 600000ms and is overridden by OVERDECK_STATE_FLUSH_WINDOW_MS when set
A single queued write produces no commit before the flush window elapses and exactly one commit after it elapses (verified with fake timers)
Flush pending auto-commits on process shutdown

expected_outputs: test proving flushAllPendingAutoCommits commits every pending root

narrative.Action: Export flushAllPendingAutoCommits() from auto-commit.ts that flushes every projectRoot currently in the pending map (await all). Call it from handleShutdownSignal in src/dashboard/server/main.ts (:514-546), before process.exit(0). Required because the 10-min window (fixed-window-debounce) would otherwise strand up to 10 min of committable state as a dirty tree (D4/H3).

items.title: flushAllPendingAutoCommits() commits every pending projectRoot and resolves after all commit attempts complete
handleShutdownSignal invokes flushAllPendingAutoCommits() before process.exit so a graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT leaves no pending state uncommitted
Push origin main ff-only after flush, with safe state-only rebase-retry-once

expected_outputs: push-policy tests pass for ff-success, non-ff-with-clean-state-only-rebase-retry, and non-ff-with-dirty-tree-surface paths using a local bare remote fixture
metadata.readinessReason: Deliberately serialized behind fixed-window-debounce and flush-on-shutdown: all three edit src/lib/pan-dir/auto-commit.ts and would conflict if worked in parallel. Also blocked by state-plane-predicate for the isStatePlaneOnlyDiff import.

narrative.Action: In doCommit, after a successful commit on main (and gated by OVERDECK_STATE_AUTOPUSH != '0'), attempt `git push origin main` ff-only. On non-ff rejection: git fetch origin main; if the working tree is clean AND isStatePlaneOnlyDiff(origin/main, main, gitRoot) is true, `git rebase origin/main` (state-only commits => content-neutral) and retry the push exactly once; otherwise log a loud warning and return without forcing (NFR-2, H2). All push/rebase steps are best-effort with the existing runGit failure-matching pattern and never throw back to the writer (NFR-1, H6). Consumes the state-plane-predicate module. Tests use fake timers and a temp bare remote.

items.title: After a flush commit on main, auto-commit runs `git push origin main` and the commit lands on origin when the push fast-forwards
When the ff push is rejected and the tree is clean with a state-only ahead-diff, auto-commit rebases onto origin/main and retries the push exactly once, succeeding
When the ff push is rejected and the tree is dirty OR an ahead-commit touches a non-state path, auto-commit does NOT rebase and emits a loud divergence warning instead
With OVERDECK_STATE_AUTOPUSH=0, auto-commit creates the commit but performs no push, leaving origin/main unchanged
A push/fetch/rebase failure is caught and logged and never throws back to the calling writer
Add getMainDivergence(repoPath) -> {ahead, behind} git helper

expected_outputs: test proving getMainDivergence reports correct ahead/behind counts against a temp remote

narrative.Action: Add getMainDivergence(repoPath): Promise<{ahead: number; behind: number}> that returns `git rev-list --count origin/main..main` (ahead) and `git rev-list --count main..origin/main` (behind), defaulting to {0,0} on any error. Co-locate it in src/lib/state-plane.ts (the state-git module) so both pan doctor and the deacon consume one implementation (D6). It does NOT fetch — callers rely on the auto-commit fetch cadence / their own fetch.
